target: Pure E2E Full Diffusion with planner-only temporal BEV and clean-state query concatenation
assumptions: Same retained current-frame indices, whole-route validation split, target normalization, frozen TF++ checkpoint, optimizer and 10-epoch schedule as full_diffusion.
Global batch 64 = 8 A100 GPUs x 8 examples; no baseline planner checkpoint warm start.
Current observation plus two consecutive past raw frames at 0.25-second spacing; no future observations and no world model.
Preserve current raw BEV for original detection and preserve original current-frame memory/checkpoint-query ego context.
Historical frozen backbone BEVs are rigidly aligned to the current augmented ego frame, channel-concatenated, convolutionally fused and gated by current speed, command and goal.
A zero-initialized output projection adds temporal/gated features as a planner-only residual before the original per-layer BEV value projections.

Encode normalized speed, six-dimensional navigation command and goal XY to 128 dimensions; concatenate with the 256-dimensional noisy trajectory query, project 384 to 256 and add residually before the decoder.
State and navigation are clean conditions, not diffused targets. Preserve pure Gaussian VP start, 100-step DDIM, x0 prediction and both-layer metric L1.
All new modules are trainable outside the frozen perception no_grad boundary; zero residual initialization initially preserves the original planner function.
